paragraphs: As in Pesachim 113a: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said in the name of the people of Jerusalem.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Pesachim 113a explicitly names Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi speaking in the name of the people of Jerusalem.

The saved Davidson Pesachim113a scalar explicitly has Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi speaking in the name of the people of Jerusalem. It supports the אריב״ל expansion and locator.
